oracle_instruction: Stop retrying apis.spotify.search_songs() — your current parameters (genre='r-n-b', year filter) are not supported by the API. Drop the genre filter and rely on min_release_date only; if the result is a list, iterate it directly instead of calling .get('songs', []).

You already have vacation_dirs from the previous step. Stop calling show_directory recursively; iterate vacation_dirs and call apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=d, access_token=t) for each subfolder. Allowed parameters are directory_path, access_token — not zip_file_path.

search_notes requires an authenticated access_token. First call apis.simple_note.login(username, password) using the password from apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords(), then pass the returned access_token to search_notes. After you obtain note_id, do NOT call phone.search_contacts until you have logged into phone the same way.

simple_note.search_notes fails without an access_token. First call apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() to retrieve the simple_note password, then apis.simple_note.login(username, password), then pass login_result['access_token'] to search_notes.

You are calling show_received_payment_requests twice with identical arguments. The first call's result list is already in scope — iterate it directly and call apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(request_id=r['request_id'], access_token=t) for each. Do NOT re-fetch the request list.

You are about to follow artists whose genre does NOT match the task. Filter the artist list by artist['genre'] == 'classical' BEFORE calling apis.spotify.follow_artist(). Discard any artist whose genre is EDM, pop, etc. Also enforce artist['followers'] >= 22 as a hard constraint.

Discard the 'all songs are liked or downloaded' heuristic — the task provides an explicit to_remove_library_song_ids set. Call apis.spotify.list_user_library_songs() and remove only the songs whose song_id is in private_data.to_remove_library_song_ids. Do NOT remove songs that are already liked or downloaded unless they are in the removal set.

You have merged songs from playlists, liked songs, downloaded songs, and albums into one candidate pool — but the task requires a specific source. Re-read the task and identify the single authoritative source (e.g. only songs released this year, only songs from one playlist) before computing the answer.

phone.get_contacts() requires an access_token. First authenticate via apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() → apis.phone.login(username, password), then use search_contacts or get_contacts with that token. After getting the contact list, identify which friends appear in private_data.pending_user_id_to_share — only those should receive venmo payment requests.

Re-read the task — 'least played' is determined by song['play_count'] (ascending), not by genre filtering. Sort the songs from apis.spotify.search_songs(query='Zoey James') by play_count ascending and pick the FIRST one. Do not exclude songs based on genre tags.

You're about to follow ALL artists across the first 5 classical playlists, but the task only wants the artists from private_data.to_be_followed_artist_ids. Filter the artists set by intersection with to_be_followed_artist_ids BEFORE calling apis.spotify.follow_artist(). Skip any artist whose id is not in the explicit allow-list.
